sfx.name: sfx_emblem_awaken
sfx.text: a short ceremonial seal awakening: sharp metallic crack of a gold medallion splitting, then a warm rising gold shimmer and a soft low brass swell that fades quickly, dry-to-short hall, no melody, no choir, no voice, no bells looping, no whoosh tail longer than a second
sfx.notes: 角色升级解锁专属纹章的庆祝音，不要复用 sfx_levelup / sfx_reveal / sfx_unlock
